New York Mets Clinch First in National League East Division
While it remains to be seen what the playoffs will bring for the <New York Mets:team#19>, the club took the first step by clinching the National League East Division title.

"It's exactly where we wanted to be and where we talked about being during spring training," said reliever <Jose Alvarado:player#38355>. "There's not a guy in the room that doesn't believe in this team. We're all pulling in the same direction right now."

It was the team's 7th division title and they will attempt to capture the franchise's 3rd Major League Baseball championship.

"The end goal hasn't changed - win the World Series," said manager <Carlos Mendoza:coach#1479>. "We think we've got the team to do it."
